Sounds good! Let's head out then. Do you want to grab a coffee before we start our shift?

Alright, let's go! I can't wait to see what kind of crazy orders we'll get today.
Let's hope for a steady flow today. I've got my favorite apron on and I'm ready to pour some perfect lattes!
See you at Hobbs Cafe, Maeve! Have a great day!
